BALTIMORE, June 4.—Daniel Wil lard, president of the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad, said yesterday he be lieved “we might expect an early and helpful decision from Congress” on balancing the budget and this would stop the “downward tendency.” The business recovery, however, he said, will be slow. “So far as business is concerned, no change for the better has appeared,” he said. “In fact, there has been a downward tendency for several months. “Even so, I am disposed to be optimistic, because I am inclined to feel that this downward tendency has been accentuated because of the uncertainty as to what Congress would do with reference to balancing the budget. “I expect the recovery will be slow, but I really believe that It will begin when Congress has done what every body is expecting and hoping that it will do.”
